note: YOUR SWITCHES. Edit on GitHub (pencil icon) and Commit — the hourly job publishes within a few minutes. Everything here can only switch things OFF; it can never add a bus time. Dates are YYYYMMDD; leave 'to' empty for 'until I remove it'. Kinds: service (all its buses), busHome (its buses are never used as a bus home), stop (a stop name as shown in the app), carpark (car park name as in the app), road (a closed road: list the carparks and services it takes out), allBuses (no buses at all). clashChoices: when two official timetable versions clash, name the version to trust (the version id shown on the monitor) or 'none' — the other version's buses are switched off that date. notice: the urgent scrolling banner — on true/false, your text, optional end date; busHomeOff true also switches off every bus-home route.
